name: ZTR — Temporal Registry
description: ZTR creates contemporaneous records of human verification for AI-assisted documents. When a professional reviews a document before filing, submitting, or approving it, ZTR hashes the document (SHA-256), timestamps the professional's declaration via an eIDAS-qualified TSA (Aruba PEC S.p.A.), and returns a retrievable receipt with HMAC integrity seal. The document is immediately discarded — never stored or transmitted beyond the hash. Receipts can be downloaded as professional PDF reports with QR codes for independent third-party verification. Currently in free technical preview.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ZTR — Temporal Registry to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ZTR — Temporal Registry to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://temporalregistry.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ZTR — Temporal Registry MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZTR — Temporal Registry provides these MCP tools: check_receipt, list_receipts, and verify_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ZTR — Temporal Registry?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ZTR — Temporal Registry in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.

_published_faq.name: Does ZTR — Temporal Registry MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZTR — Temporal Registry requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ZTR — Temporal Registry is developed by Temporal Registry. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
